name: Dawn Neal
reason: Too thin from what we could reach: her own site, liberatingdharma.org (named on her dharma.org page), failed to connect on 6 Nov 2026 (no response over HTTPS; not retried), so the only usable source was Insight Santa Cruz, where she is Guiding Teacher, which shows just two current programmes of hers (a silent daylong and a Sunday sit and talk); her AudioDharma talks have no confirmed page of her own. Worth another try if her site comes back: photo, centre email (info@insightsantacruz.org) and Santa Cruz base are all available.
